This page attempts to provide a complete overview over the scientific processes represented by QUINCY. As any model documentation, it will lag behind the actual implementation in the code, and interested users
are advised to consult the inline documentation for potential updates. 

### Table of Content 

- @sec-structure summarises the general structure and vertical discretisation of vegetation and soil. 
- @sec-assimi describes the canopy processes, such as photosynthesis and stomatal coupling. 
- @sec-veg introduces vegetation growth, turnover and dynamics. 
- @sec-soil-biogeochemistry provides an overview of the simple soil biogeochemistry implementation.
- @sec-isotopic-composition-and-fractionation introduces the isotope processes of QUINCY.
- @sec-rad describes the simplified QUINCY radiation scheme, surface energy
balance and soil hydrology.
